classes.summary: The Printers class is a mobile automation flow class for Android Smart printer management. It inherits from SmartFlow and provides comprehensive printer discovery, selection, and management capabilities. Key patterns include: (1) Exception handling with configurable raise_e parameters for flexible error management, (2) Explicit wait patterns with timeout parameters for handling asynchronous UI loading, (3) Element location using string identifiers for locators, (4) State verification methods for validating printer status, (5) CRUD operations for printer management (add, select, remove, verify). The class follows a page object model pattern with methods encapsulating specific user interactions. Notable implementation details include handling of printer discovery failures through 'My printer is not listed' fallback option, dynamic element location for printer names in lists, and robust waiting mechanisms for list loading. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for mobile automation with TimeoutException, NoSuchElementException, and StaleElementReferenceException handling.
